# Cross-Stacked Retreat — illustration reference

Design revision: 2.0.0 · schema containers-hamlet-design/v2.0 · design hash a8e30d3c

This description is generated from the canonical design model. The reference SVG is the authoritative geometric reference. The illustration prompt is an interpretation.

## Architectural facts
- 2 occupied storeys
- 2 container modules (40ft, 40ft)
- butterfly roof at 12 degrees
- 59.5 m2 gross floor area
- 53.5 m2 ground coverage
- 8.26 m to the roof

## Modules
- **m1** — storey 1, 12.192 × 2.438 m, base 0.6 m, rotation 0°, metal cladding.
- **m2** — storey 2, 12.192 × 2.438 m, base 3.896 m, rotation 90°, timber cladding. m2 is aligned with m1, rotated 90 degrees clockwise relative to m1.

## Openings
- m1 / North window — north window, 1.2 × 1.2 m, sill 1 m.
- m1 / Living doors — south sliding-door, 2.8 × 2.1 m, sill 0 m.
- m1 / Entry door — east door, 0.95 × 2.1 m, sill 0 m.
- m1 / West window — west window, 1.2 × 1.3 m, sill 0.9 m.
- m2 / Upper studio window — north window, 1.6 × 1.4 m, sill 0.8 m.
- m2 / Upper bedroom window — south window, 1.6 × 1.4 m, sill 0.8 m.
- m2 / Upper balcony door — east door, 0.9 × 2.1 m, sill 0 m.
- m2 / Upper window — west window, 1.2 × 1.2 m, sill 1 m.

## Rooms and zones
- m1 / Living — living, 0–5 m. Ground-floor essential living.
- m1 / Kitchen — kitchen, 5–7.8 m. Ground-floor kitchen.
- m1 / Bathroom — bathroom, 7.8–9.6 m. Ground-floor bathroom.
- m1 / Stair — circulation, 9.6–12 m. Internal stair; no lift or lift space.
- m2 / Sleeping — sleeping, 0–4.4 m. Upper bedroom; stair only.
- m2 / Bathroom — bathroom, 4.4–6.4 m. Upper bathroom; stair only.
- m2 / Studio — work, 6.4–10.4 m. Upper studio; stair only.
- m2 / Storage — storage, 10.4–12 m. Upper storage.

## Outdoor spaces
- p1: 4.2 × 2.8 m covered porch on the south face of m1.

## Site and camera
- Assigned site: Cabin D (site rotation 16°).
- Principal view: The beaver meadow: open sedge, alder and standing water, with the south knoll and its rock shoulder beyond.
- Path approach: north
- Camera: exterior three-quarter view, 1.6 m, 35 mm, bearing 231°.

## Interior schedule
- Living (living) — 11.17 m², m1, inferred-from-zone.
- Kitchen (kitchen) — 6.11 m², m1, inferred-from-zone.
- Bathroom (bathroom) — 3.81 m², m1, inferred-from-zone.
- Stair (circulation) — 5.19 m², m1, inferred-from-zone.
- Sleeping (sleeping) — 9.79 m², m2, inferred-from-zone.
- Bathroom (bathroom) — 4.27 m², m2, inferred-from-zone.
- Studio (work) — 8.87 m², m2, inferred-from-zone.
- Storage (storage) — 3.36 m², m2, inferred-from-zone.
- Partitions: 0 · doors: 0 · fixtures: 0.
- Validation: 0 invalid, 10 unresolved, 8 review.

## Fire and water services
- Fire intent: roof class A; noncombustible deck: false; fire-water access confirmed: false; defensible space: 10 m (conceptual).
- Rainwater: conceptual; storage cistern; potable: false; fire reserve separate: true; fire connection verified: false.
- Fire protection, fire-water access and rainwater collection are conceptual intents/unknowns. No fire-resistance rating, WUI approval, tank sizing, potable-water testing or fire-service connection is designed.

## Intentions
- Step-free entrance is a design intent, not a verified measurement.
- Adaptable bathroom is a design intent, not a verified layout.
- Adaptable kitchen is a design intent, not a verified layout.
- Butterfly roof is an exterior form; the interior ceiling is not resolved.

- **fire-water-access-unconfirmed**: Fire-service water access is not confirmed. Do not draw a working hydrant, cistern or draft point as if verified.
- **combustible-deck**: The deck/porch is not recorded as noncombustible. Combustible decking, stored firewood and under-floor storage are fire risks; do not present them as resolved.
- **fire-separation-not-assessed**: Inter-storey and inter-module fire separation, protected egress and cavity barriers are not assessed. Do not imply a fire-resistance rating.
